sources.label: Morphe patches for Quora: remove ads and disable analytics
sources.author: JoFSlash
patch_list: Blocks requests from Quora pages to third-party analytics and tracking services.
Turns off Firebase Analytics, Crashlytics, Firebase Performance and Facebook app events, and stops the advertising ID from being collected.
Stops the app from asking you to rate it on Google Play.
Stops the app from showing the Google Play update screen.
Opens links to other websites in your default browser instead of an in-app browser tab.
Hides promoted answers, sponsored posts and Google ads in the feed and on question pages, and blocks requests to ad servers.
